name: tpf2-mod-studio
description: Standalone desktop workbench for Transport Fever 2 mod development.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tpf2-mod-studio/core && npm run build -w @tpf2-mod-studio/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tpf2-mod-studio/core && npm run typecheck -w @tpf2-mod-studio/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
